Start with the expanded examples. Open further examples for options and alternative R approaches.

ttest

Two-sample t test

Stata 

ttest x, by(group)

R stats 

t.test(x ~ group, data = data)

Differs from Stata R's default is Welch's test; add var.equal = TRUE for Stata's default equal-variance test.

Stata reference · R reference

univar

Detailed univariate statistics

Stata 

univar x1 x2

R tidystata 

summ(data, x1, x2, .detail = TRUE)
